dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Serrated, high-contrast light-intensity boundaries forming irregular closed and semi-closed loops; sharp pixel gradient transition from the dark dorsal pelt exterior to the bright white-grey perimeter lines, most prominent in the superior-central and upper-left regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters, primarily concentrated at the vertices of intersecting annuli and as isolated points along the mid-lateral pelt transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent annular structures in the superior dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with a fourth prominent centroid in the mid-central region creating an irregular quadrilateral spatial relationship.
